programs.name: IHDA Access Home

amount.text: 6% of the purchase price up to $15,000

programs.repayment: interest-free loan, deferred for the life of the mortgage; repaid when you sell, refinance or pay off the mortgage
programs.firstTimeNote: homebuyers and their spouses must be first-time buyers or exempt (eligible veteran, or a home in a targeted area)
programs.contribution: $1,000 or 1% of the purchase price, whichever is greater

incomeLimit.text: AccessHome income and purchase price limits by county, effective on reservations dated July 1, 2026 and after

programs.quote: 6% of the purchase price up to $15,000 in assistance for down payment & closing costs offered as an interest-free loan, deferred for the life of your mortgage

programs.name: IHDA Access Forgivable

amount.text: 4% of the purchase price up to $6,000

programs.contribution: $1,000 or 1% of the purchase price, whichever is greater
programs.quote: 4% of the purchase price up to $6,000 in assistance for down payment & closing costs, forgiven monthly over 10 years

programs.name: IHDA Access Deferred

amount.text: 5% of the purchase price up to $7,500

programs.repayment: interest-free, deferred for the life of the mortgage; repaid on sale, refinance or payoff
programs.quote: 5% of the purchase price up to $7,500 in assistance for down payment & closing costs offered as an interest-free loan, deferred for the life of your mortgage

programs.name: IHDA Access Repayable

amount.text: 10% of the purchase price up to $10,000

programs.repayment: interest-free loan repaid monthly over 10 years
programs.quote: 10% of the purchase price up to $10,000 in assistance for down payment & closing costs offered as an interest-free loan, repaid monthly over a 10 year period
